title: YAMNet Preprocess
text: Preprocess audio for YAMNet classification, 1 input, 1 output, no direct feedthrough; {Sample rate of input signal (Hz)} sets the sample rate of input signal and {Overlap percentage (%)} sets the overlap percentage between consecutive mel. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: features
ports.summary: Mel spectrograms that can be fed to YAMNet pretrained network 96-by-64 matrix

params.name: Sample rate of input signal (Hz)
params.values: Sample rate of input signal in Hz 16e3 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Overlap percentage (%)
params.values: Overlap percentage between consecutive mel spectrograms 50 (default) | [0 100)
